prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: seamless PBR base-colour surface scan for small weathered granite stones in a realistic tidal harbour game environment.
Create a perfectly flat orthographic, cross-polarized photographic scan of one continuous worn dark grey granite surface, filling the entire square image. This image represents 50 cm by 50 cm of real stone, so mineral crystals should be fine, mostly 1 to 3 mm across. Subtle charcoal mica specks, muted pale grey feldspar grains, a little soft grey-brown oxidation and restrained tonal mottling. Water-worn, subtly pitted mineral surface, neither polished nor shiny. The stone must feel solid, dense and natural, with no loud decorative vein pattern.
Even neutral diffuse lighting and true surface colour only: no cast shadows, highlights, baked ambient occlusion, directional shading or edge falloff. Overall muted medium-dark neutral grey; close tonal range with fine believable detail, not stark black and white speckle.
Seamless on all four edges. Continuous mineral texture only: no block outlines, masonry joints, mortar, stones piled together, gravel, large cracks, slabs, rock silhouette, circular object, terrain, plants, moss, puddles, lettering, border or watermark. Avoid stretched veins, concentric rings, wood grain, terrazzo, salt-and-pepper noise and high contrast marbling. Opaque image.
